title: Publish Personal Universe as a working GitHub Pages project site

scope.subject: Online production preview hosting and Astro repository-subpath compatibility

research_summary: GitHub Pages is already wired into the repository and requires no third-party project or deploy secret. Astro officially supports repository project sites through the base option. A repository scan found only four remaining root-relative runtime asset references, while vendored landmark assets already use import.meta.env.BASE_URL. Therefore a small BASE_URL migration plus an Astro base setting is lower risk than adding Cloudflare or Vercel solely to obtain a root-hosted URL. Keep Cloudflare Pages and Vercel as mature fallbacks if Pages enablement or plan settings block publication.

sources.finding: Astro officially supports GitHub Pages project sites by setting site and base so generated and internal paths use the repository subpath.
GitHub Pages custom workflows deploy static artifacts using configure-pages, upload-pages-artifact and deploy-pages with Pages/OIDC permissions.
Cloudflare Pages supports private GitHub repositories, automatic production builds and branch/PR preview URLs on a root pages.dev hostname.
Vercel Git integration automatically deploys production branches and creates preview deployments for branch pushes and pull requests.

search_ladder.conclusion: Cloudflare Pages and Vercel both provide mature root-hosted production and PR preview deployments, but each requires an external project/account integration that is unnecessary if the existing Pages path needs only a small base-path fix.
Astro has first-class site/base configuration and exposes import.meta.env.BASE_URL for client asset URLs, covering repository-subpath compatibility without a custom URL framework.

GitHub Pages Actions is already present, uses the same repository identity and requires no third-party deployment token; it is the lowest-integration-cost production host if base-path compatibility is clean.
The needed runtime migration is limited to replacing four hard-coded root-relative public asset references with Astro/Vite BASE_URL semantics; no package is required.

candidates.name: GitHub Pages + Astro base/BASE_URL
candidates.source: GitHub Pages Actions and Astro project-site configuration
candidates.reason: Reuses the already-integrated deployment workflow and requires only a small, centralized base-path migration found by repository scan.

candidates.name: Astro base + import.meta.env.BASE_URL
candidates.reason: Makes public assets work both at local root and under /personal-universe without hand-maintained URL rewriting.

candidates.name: Cloudflare Pages Git integration
candidates.reason: Excellent root hosting and PR previews for private repositories, but requires external account/GitHub App setup that is unnecessary if Pages works after the small base-path fix.

candidates.name: Vercel Preview Deployments
candidates.reason: Mature zero-config Astro hosting with PR previews, but also requires an external project connection; retain as fallback rather than duplicating hosting now.

coverage_matrix.capability: Working public production URL without Windows
coverage_matrix.decision: Use the existing Pages workflow once Astro/public asset paths are repository-subpath safe.
All three hosts are viable on paid/private-repo-compatible plans; Pages has the lowest integration cost because it is already in-repo.
Accept one production Pages URL now; use Cloudflare/Vercel later only if per-PR live URLs materially outweigh the extra account integration.
Keep URLs base-aware so switching to a custom domain/root host later is configuration-only.

decision.rationale: The root-relative scan proves Pages compatibility is a small change, so reuse GitHub Pages and Astro's official base semantics rather than adding a new hosting vendor. Cloudflare Pages and Vercel remain ready fallbacks if repository Pages enablement cannot be satisfied.

higher_level_tradeoffs.reason: Superior automatic PR preview URLs, but external GitHub App/account setup is a larger integration cost than four BASE_URL fixes.
Strong Astro zero-config hosting and rollbacks, but requires an external project connection and is unnecessary for the first stable online URL.

decision.fallback: If GitHub Pages cannot be enabled for this private repository/account, connect Vercel or Cloudflare Pages and deploy the same static Astro build at root without reverting the BASE_URL-safe asset changes.
